rows.grounds: abstract noun from kāndiśīka (point, center) with -tva suffix; culmination of the prior resting phase
expresses arrival at the culminating condition
fused form of paraśaktau + asau; locative reference to the supreme power as the locus
emphasizes that this state arises even within the supreme power

items.question: What culminating state is reached even within the supreme power?
premises: The preceding phase abides in supreme bliss and wonder.
That abiding occurs within the supreme power.
Even there a further condition of becoming a point is attained.
items.inference: Therefore the culmination within the supreme power is a point-like concentration.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of kāndiśīka as point, center, or seed in this Krama context is not fully determined.
items.plain_english: Even within that supreme power, it attains the state of becoming a single point.
